original_source: M=n*r-2 fresh even-native qutrits, independently uniform paired vector frequencies at original modulus3^r; common UNKNOWN secret.
solver_input: Deeply immutable nuisance-group labels: target component reduced moduloq/3, all other components full modq; independent uniform targets for coverage benchmarks.
implemented_receiver: Known reversible syndrome evaluation, retained source word register, ordinary low-input MITM pair computation in separate workspace, coherent two-endpoint projector, full-basis reversible compression, inverse F3 trit measurement, random guess on all failures.
source_average_transfer_for_each_fixed_u: Informative acceptance4*beta; raw least-trit success1/3+4*beta/3 under stripped-input pair selection.
implemented_reference_cost: Exponential3^floor(M/2)+3^ceil(M/2) half-table assignments; at most two retained words per left residue. Budget aborts never return partial certified pairs.

proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-REVIEW: Independent review of simplex unit-minor moment proof, high-trit independence, ordinary workspace factorization and all-failure transfer.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-PAIR-FINDER: Prove polynomial capped runtime and inverse-polynomial two-witness coverage on the actual uniform-target nuisance distribution, including empty and singleton targets.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-POLICY: Selection must use only stripped labels and solver randomness; high-target frequency trits may verify delta after selection, not silently choose a favorable replacement.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-AVERAGE-CASE: Do not transfer average single-witness guarantees to two-witness or adaptive first-difference subinstances without a proof.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-RUNTIME: Physical syndrome law is size-biased; prove a uniform-runtime cap or the occupancy-weighted average, and charge source retention and aborts.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-SOURCE: Charge all M original native inputs per attempt;8M/3 expected binary inputs only when independent original vector phase access is actually available.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-ONEHOT: Preserve ternary digit choice0,1,2; two unrestricted Boolean selections per register are a different problem.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-HARDWARE: Compile controlled modular additions, equality projector, qutrit permutation and inverse F3 with aggregate error bounds.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-NATURAL-REDUCTION: Cyclic DHSP supplies scalar phase access; vector-secret lattice/HSP implications need explicit independent reductions.
proof_obligations_before_candidate_accep.PO-FULL-SECRET: Use and charge the existing conditional bootstrap only after the weak learner guarantee is actually established.

falsifiers: Original full-root Born amplitudes disagree with the claimed trit phase or non-target coordinates do not cancel.
A projector measures which endpoint or discards a secret-dependent anchor before it is global in a measured branch.
A planted/size-biased target or only successful runtime is reported as uniform-target coverage.
High-trit-dependent endpoint selection is treated as the stripped-input4*beta theorem.
Singleton-only coverage, identical solver outputs, or budget-exhausted partial lists count as pairs.
Exponential MITM, q27 controls or a constant-factor known sieve improvement is promoted to a Shor-level algorithm.
A known classical phase-tag source replaces the UNKNOWN native phase states.
